notes: Fergus, Apjones, Mad Anthony ('MAD ANTHONY'), Chambers and Dane are printed bare; written with Street. Pullan is 60' (printed) west of Chambers and 45' (printed twice) east of it: the north face is straight (y~693) and the south face steps from y~1057 to ~963 at Chambers, so the Chambers/Pullan T is put midway between the north face and the two south corners (y 852; the 60' and 45' centrelines are at ~876 and ~829). Chambers is labelled '(50' WIDE)' but drawn only ~218 px (about 36 ft); its centre is taken between the drawn faces. Fergus runs NNE-SSW across the sheet and continues north of Pullan (that leg is labelled FERGUS on sheet 635), so Fergus/Pullan is a cross; Fergus's slope changes slightly at Apjones (about 1.6 deg), where the T is set between the offset block corners. Fergus continues south of Chase (key map and sheet 633); this sheet draws the outline of the 625 block south of Chase starting at x~110, just inside the paper edge. Dane (66' printed): only its west face (x~6260) is on the paper (edge ~6540). Every other pipe on this sheet runs on its street centre (including Chambers, which is drawn narrow), and the 10 in. pipe in Dane runs 126-135 px east of the west face (x ~6396 at the top to ~6376 at the bottom), so Dane is taken as drawn ~43 ft wide and the three Dane points are put on the pipe. If Dane were really drawn 66 ft wide, its true centre would be ~70 px east of these points (x~6460). Pullan and Apjones east of Dane are off the paper (Pullan/Dane marked T, Apjones/Dane cross per key map). The Chase pipe continues east past Dane, so Chase/Dane is a cross. No alleys on this sheet.
